name: proof-window-day
eval: if(!__sw.scene.getObjectByName('survey-window-proof')){const t=(await __sw.model('data-tower-a',0,'v3')).clone(true);t.name='survey-window-proof';t.position.set(30,0,105);__sw.scene.add(t);__sw.renderer.shadowMap.needsUpdate=true;}let n=0,bad=0;__sw.scene.getObjectByName('survey-window-proof').traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh&&m.material.name==='city.window'){n++;if(m.material!==__sw.windows.material)bad++;}});if(!n||bad)throw Error('window panes not routed: '+n+' panes, '+bad+' unrouted');
